typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblpegamessagesscopfx_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Urgency as string,
		ID as string,
		Received_via as string,
		Status as string,
		Sender_Address as string,
		Country as string,
		Receiver_Address as string,
		MT as string,
		NACK as string,
		Sender_TRN as string,
		Receiver_TRN as string,
		Amount as string,
		CCY as string,
		Work_Type as string,
		Instructions as string,
		GPI as string,
		PXASSIGNEDOPERATORID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> PegaMessages
PegaMessages split(ltrim(toString(rtrim(toString(ID),' ')),' ') == '', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Case1,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput derive({Derived Column 1} = iif(toString(PXASSIGNEDOPERATORID) == 'FXMS', 'R', 'S')) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Status as string,
		GPI as string,
		Receiver_address as string,
		MT as string,
		Amount as string,
		Sender_TRN as string,
		Instructions as string,
		MsgType as string,
		Receiver_TRN as string,
		Sender_address as string,
		CCY as string,
		Country as string,
		Received_via as string,
		Work_type as string,
		ID as string,
		Urgency as string,
		NACK as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Status,
		GPI,
		Receiver_address = Receiver_Address,
		MT,
		Amount,
		Sender_TRN,
		Instructions,
		MsgType = {Derived Column 1},
		Receiver_TRN,
		Sender_address = Sender_Address,
		CCY,
		Country,
		Received_via,
		Work_type = Work_Type,
		ID,
		Urgency,
		NACK),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblpegamessagesscopfx_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblpegamessagesscopfx
